{{Removed|date=8th of May 2021}} {{For|[[Super Mutant]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Wasted Boss |image1 = WastedBoss.png |mode_appearance = [[Fallen Mode|{{Color|LegacyFallenMode|Fallen}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 10 ([[Polluted Wasteland]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]500 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (5) |spawned_by = *[[Mystery]] ([[Polluted Wasteland]] Fallen) *[[Mystery Boss]] ([[Polluted Wasteland]] Fallen) *[[Ultra Mystery]] (Formerly) *[[Uber Mystery]] (Formerly) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A thick skinned boss is on its way!
We need to get a lot of heavy damage to take down this slow but menacing foe.|[[Commander/Gallery#Commander Dialogue|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} {{QuoteBox|Incoming boss!|Beginning of Wave 10 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Wasted Boss''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] found exclusively in [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, replacing the [[Abnormal Boss]]. It was much faster than the [[Abnormal Boss]] (just slightly slower than the [[Radioactive]]) and had a lot more health. The '''Wasted Boss''' was also spawned by the [[Mystery]] and [[Mystery Boss]] upon their deaths in [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Wasted Boss''' had dark beige skin with black metal-plated torso and legs. It had white eyes, with radioactive waste leaking out of its eyes and mouth. It also had tumors on its head and left arm. Its head was slightly tilted downwards. Additionally, a yellow radioactive pack could be found on its back. ==Strategy== *Place your towers in the center of the [[Polluted Wasteland]] map to maximize their range. **When the '''Wasted Boss''' debuts, you should have [[Minigunner]]s, [[Ranger]]s or [[Accelerator]]s to bring it down. **Cheap towers that can deal a decent amount of damage, such as the [[Militant]] or [[Crook Boss]], are also recommended against the '''Wasted Boss'''. *You can use the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Electroshocker]] to slow the '''Wasted Boss''' down. *Many [[Humvee 2]]s or [[Humvee 3]]s from the [[Military Base]] can be effective at chipping away at the '''Wasted Boss'''' health. ==Update History== *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Wasted Boss''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **No longer appears in Golden mode as it has been removed. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Wasted Boss''' removed. {{GoldenNuclear|[[Radioactive]]|Wave 7|Wasted Boss|Wave 10|[[Shadow]]|Wave 13}} {{FallenNuclear|[[Radioactive]]|Wave 7|Wasted Boss|Wave 10|[[Shadow]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Polluted Wasteland]]
